### When Grace Defeated the Monster
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-february-4-2025.html
Passage: Romans 5:20-21
Points:
- Salvation is entirely God's work of grace reaching down to sinners.
- Adam's fall unleashed sin into the world, but God's grace abounds far more.
- Believers are given a new identity to reign in life through Jesus Christ.
- God's enduring grace forgives, restores, and holds secure those who stumble.

### A Superior Union
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/a-superior-union
Passage: Romans 5:15-17
Points:
- Adam brought death as the natural fruit of sin, but Christ brings life through supernatural grace.
- Christ's redemption atoned not only for original sin but for every rebellion of His people.
- Believers receive imputed righteousness to reign in life rather than remain under death's rule.
- Union with Christ lifts believers to a position far greater than Adam's pre-fall condition.
